'''Hynah''' was an [[Factory world/Legends|industrial world]] located in the [[Kalamith sector/Legends|Kalamith sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]]. It was home to the [[Hynese]], a cosmopolitan population of various different [[Species/Legends|species]]. Prior to the [[Evacuation of Yavin|evacuation]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] [[Great Temple/Legends|base]], Rebel [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] [[Star map/Legends|charted]] an escape [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] leading from the [[Feswe Corridor]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] to Hynah.

==Description==
Hynah was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Hynah system/Legends|Hynah system]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Kalamith sector/Legends|Kalamith sector]]. It was situated between the [[Simpla system/Legends|Simpla]] and [[Sorrus system/Legends|Sorrus systems]] on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]], which served as a dividing line between the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] and [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] regions.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
When, following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] prepared for the imminent [[Evacuation of Yavin|evacuation]] of its [[Great Temple/Legends|base]] in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]], Rebel [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] [[Star map/Legends|charted]] several emergency [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] escape [[Hyperspace route/Legends|routes]] from the [[Feswe Corridor]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]], including one running to Hynah via the [[Feswe Prime system/Legends|Feswe Prime system]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|Hynese}}
A bustling [[Factory world/Legends|industrial world]], Hynah had an enterpreneurial and cosmopolitan population, known as the [[Hynese]], which consisted of members of various [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Hynese had a presence in the adjacent [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]], with their interests being represented in the [[Agriworld/Legends|agricultural]] [[Jovan system/Legends|Jovan system]] and both the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] planet [[Selitan]] and the [[Factory/Legends|industrial]] world [[Krylon]] being dominated by Hynese companies. On Hynah, jokes were common about the relatively backward ways of the inhabitants of the Gordian Reach.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hynah was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]]. Although it was placed in grid square O-5 by the book's map of the Gordian Reach, both the Appendix section of the book<ref name="TEA" /> and the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to that work incorrectly placed the Hynah system in grid square P-5 instead.<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>
